regimens.dose_text: 15 to 20 mg/kg IV every 8 to 12 hours (usual initial adult dose 1 g to 1.5 g IV every 12 hours). Administer by IV infusion over at least 60 minutes at a rate not exceeding 10 mg/min to prevent infusion-related reactions (red man syndrome). Therapeutic drug monitoring required: target AUC/MIC 400 to 600 or trough 15 to 20 mcg/mL.
